comingLast.roast: in the clubhouse on 19 - somebody sit with him, it is a tense wait
on 16 with 4 to play - scratch the plan, just add points, any points
in the clubhouse 2 above Pieper - cheering for him from a safe distance
in with a 3-point moat - drawbridge stuck halfway up
safe-ish by 3 - the blue balls have come back from further
in on a cushion of 3 - refreshing the board between sips
his round is over, his sweating is not - 3 above the line
finished 4 clear of the blue balls - now buying Pieper drinks out of gratitude
in on a 4-point buffer - watching the door like everyone else
